headline: On October 10, 2022: Bernanke, Diamond and Dybvig win Nobel
captionCards: Named 2009 Time Person of the Year for crisis response
Research analyzes the Great Depression to prevent future crashes
instagramCaption:
Ben Bernanke joins Douglas Diamond and Philip H. Dybvig in receiving the 2022 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences.

The trio was honored for their research on banks and financial crises, specifically analyzing the Great Depression. Bernanke previously served as the 14th Federal Reserve chairman from 2006 to 2014. He oversaw the central bank's response to the 2008 financial crisis during his tenure.

Their work provides critical insights into preventing future economic collapses.
